title: Tiny, cute rose
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <path d='M50 62 C50 75, 47 85, 44 94' stroke='#3ddc84' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='22' fill='#e5386d'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='33' r='13' fill='#ff6b8a'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='33' r='13' fill='#ff6b8a'/>

</svg>
